evidenceKind: literal LiveHime preview canvas extraction from root native screenshot

targetVerification.method: root per-image SHA-256 allowlist plus fresh geometry confirmation

changes: rectangle extraction and PNG encoding only; no image content edited
limitations: This extraction script does not interact with LiveHime or claim a capture acceptance result.
Original screenshot remains private; only the preview canvas may be considered for public evidence after inspection.
Screenshot dimensions are checked automatically. Canvas position is separately attested by the root fresh UI observation supplied on the command line.
The input must also be explicitly root-approved by its exact source SHA-256. A requested application name or matching screenshot size alone is never treated as proof of the captured application.
A JPEG native screenshot has no transparency channel; capture transparency must be judged against the deliberate test background and separate operational observations.
Pixel comparison numbers are descriptive only. JPEG compression and live rendering may cause differences; no automatic visual pass/fail is inferred.
